children: Walrus Pump Debuts at 2026 TAIWAN EXPO USA: From Pumps to Liquid Cooling System Integration
TAIPEI, Taiwan, Sept. 21, 2026

-- With the rapid growth of high-performance computing (HPC) and AI applications, data center thermal management has become a key requirement for next-generation computing infrastructure. Walrus Pump, a Taiwan-based pump specialist, will exhibit at the 2026 TAIWAN EXPO USA from September 24 to 26, with cooling solutions as its main theme. The company will showcase three high-tech pump series: TPMS, CMP, and TPHK-S. These products support applications including in-row and in-rack coolant distribution units (CDUs) and immersion cooling, demonstrating Walrus Pump's ability to integrate pump technology into cooling systems.
As AI Computing Density Rises, Stable Cooling Becomes Critical

As AI servers move toward greater computing power and higher power consumption, data centers also need cooling systems that are more efficient, more stable, and more flexible in space utilization. As the core fluid control equipment in any liquid cooling system, pumps directly affect how well the whole system runs through their performance, reliability, and size.

Walrus Pump has long specialized in fluid control technology. Year after year, it has invested substantially in AI liquid cooling applications and has built a proven track record with major global companies and leading Taiwanese makers of cooling modules and systems. Walrus Pump is now extending its existing pump manufacturing expertise into modular customization, product configuration, and system integration, making the pump not just a single component but a piece of core fluid equipment for data center liquid cooling.
Three Featured Products Built for Different Configurations, Making It Easier to Select, Deploy, and Integrate
1. TPMS Horizontal Centrifugal Pump | In-Row CDU
The pump adopts exclusive Japanese technology featuring an ultra-slim IE5 permanent magnet motor, making the overall size two-thirds smaller.
It is equipped with patented leak detection, with sensors that monitor the pump in real time.
2. CMP DC Sealless Pump | In-Rack CDU
Its structural design can be optimized for either 4U or 6U configurations, with an adjustable outlet angle.
In a standard 4U rack setup, it delivers 20% higher performance than comparable products.
3. TPHK-S Submersible Centrifugal Pump | Immersion Cooling System

It features a patented return-flow design that prevents coolant leaks and environmental contamination. Targeting a wide range of liquid applications, Walrus Pump offers a choice of materials for the pump body and shaft seal, and these pumps have already been adopted in the data center supply chain serving the global AI-related and semiconductor industries.
From Selling a Single Pump to Providing a Complete Solution

For customers, every liquid cooling setup is different, with its own requirements for space, flow rate, efficiency, fluid compatibility, and safety monitoring. Choosing the right pump means matching these varied needs precisely. Walrus Pump not only focuses on single pump products but also provides corresponding pump specs and integrated supporting components based on each system's structure, helping customers streamline communication throughout product adoption.

Walrus Pump continues to position itself for future microchannel lid cooling requirements and is driving the development of brushless DC (BLDC) motor technology, enabling its pump products to evolve to meet the growing demands for efficiency, flexibility, intelligence, and energy savings.

For Walrus Pump, data center liquid cooling is more than just a new product application. It is a key direction for extending its pump technology into the high-end technology market. As global AI infrastructure continues to expand, the company will use its high-tech pump capabilities in modular customization and system integration to deepen cooperation with upstream and downstream partners across the data center supply chain and will leverage Taiwan’s manufacturing and R&D capabilities to compete for the global high-end pump application market.
